caption: Where each one's data comes from
code:
Trailhead Playground   -> starts empty, yours alone
Developer Edition org  -> starts empty, yours alone
Sandbox                -> starts as a COPY of a real company's org

A sandbox always belongs to one specific production org.
A Playground or Developer Edition org never does.
